# DockMagic 1.1

## What's new

- Add AI Usage Widgets for Claude and Codex plan limits and daily token usage.
- Improve Google Analytics Widgets with richer overview metrics, breakdowns, and data loading.
- Improve Cloudflare traffic and security details, domain selection, and account authorization.
- Improve Gmail unread Widgets, account selection, message loading, and request handling.
- Refine storage charts, loading states, and volume reporting.
- Improve popup focus handling and Widget interaction feedback across Dock placements.

## Compatibility and installation

- Requires macOS 14.0 or later. Supports Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
- Existing users can enable Check for Update in Settings to install this release.
- For a manual installation, download the disk image and drag DockMagic into Applications.
- AI Usage Widgets require the corresponding Claude or Codex tools and an authenticated local account. Google and Cloudflare integrations require account authorization.
- License activation and verification require an internet connection.

# DockMagic 1.0

The first release of DockMagic, an independent Widget Dock for macOS.

## Features

- Place your DockMagic Dock at the bottom, left, or right of a display.
- Choose, arrange, resize, and customize Widgets for system activity, network traffic, batteries, sound, clocks, calendars, Gmail, and power controls.
- Link Google accounts to read Gmail through read-only Widgets and a message popup.
- Use the free Widget selection or activate a lifetime license for additional styles.
- Enable Check for Update in Settings to receive future releases.

## Compatibility and installation

- Requires macOS 14.0 or later.
- Download the disk image, open it, and drag DockMagic into Applications.
- Launch DockMagic from Applications. Settings, Show Dock, and Quit are available from its menu bar icon.
- Gmail requires Google authorization. Calendar and other protected features request their relevant macOS permissions.
- License activation and verification require an internet connection.
